n179a87f8ae.headline: New Angolan Customs Tariff will stimulate diversification
n179a87f8ae.summary: At a consultation forum in Luanda, Angola introduced a new Customs Tariff project based on the 2017 Harmonized System to support economic diversification.
n179a87f8ae.why: Customs tariff reforms can influence trade flows, government revenue, and diversification efforts in resource-dependent economies like Angola.

n417a8ad0ee.headline: NSE LIVE! Equities in marginal recovery with N5bn gain
n417a8ad0ee.summary: Nigerian equities regained an upward trend with a N5 billion gain as investors sought value stocks after a four-day rally pause.
n417a8ad0ee.why: Nigeria's stock market is a key indicator of economic sentiment in Africa's largest economy, and such movements reflect investor confidence and liquidity conditions.
